title: Protein extraction from Aurantiochytrium limacinum (ATCC MYA-1381)
author: Anbarasu Karthikaichamy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc7gizjw

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions and Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary stock solutions and the lysis buffer (LyB).

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 ml of lysis buffer (LyB) using the above chemicals.

steps.title: Harvest Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Isolate the cell pellet from the cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Pipette ~3 ml of cell suspension from the test tube or conical flask.
Centrifuge the cells at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant and keep the cell pellet on ice.

steps.title: Extract Soluble Protein Fraction
steps.instruction: Extract the soluble protein fraction using lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml of lysis buffer (LyB) to the cell pellet.
Vortex the mixture on high speed for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the suspension at 13500 rpm for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Collect the supernatant in a separate tube and place it on ice; this is the soluble fraction.

steps.title: Extract Insoluble Protein Fraction
steps.instruction: Extract the insoluble protein fraction from the remaining pellet.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 4x LDS sample buffer.
Add the required amount of dH2O.
Add 25% β-Mercaptoethanol at a 1:10 (v:v) ratio (perform this step in a fume hood).
Heat the mixture at 70 °C for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the mixture at 13500 rpm for 20 minutes at 4 °C.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant (insoluble fraction) into a fresh tube and keep it on ice.
Quantify the protein extract using an appropriate method.
Visualize proteins on an SDS-PAGE gel stained with Coomassie blue.
